display.name: HubSpot
display.blurb: Read and write HubSpot CRM records — contacts, companies, deals, and tickets — plus owners and property metadata. Authenticated with a private app access token, brokered at the egress proxy and never seen by the agent.

cli.doc:
Use `hubspot` to read and write HubSpot CRM records from this session — contacts, companies, deals, tickets — plus owners and property metadata. Authentication is automatic: the egress proxy injects the private app access token on requests to api.hubapi.com; `HUBSPOT_TOKEN` is a managed placeholder. Do NOT set a real token or run any login.

Each subcommand needs the matching power on your profile; a call to a path your profile didn't grant is denied at the network boundary, not authenticated.

List records: `hubspot list <object> [field=value ...]` (e.g. `hubspot list contacts limit=10 properties=email,firstname,lastname`). <object> is contacts|companies|deals|tickets. Requires the `<object>:read` power (e.g. `contacts:read`).
Get one record: `hubspot get <object> <id> [properties=a,b]` — requires `<object>:read`.
Search records: `hubspot search <object> <filterProperty> <operator> <value>` — POSTs a filtered search (operator is EQ|NEQ|GT|LT|CONTAINS_TOKEN|HAS_PROPERTY…). Requires `<object>:read`.
Create a record: `hubspot create <object> prop=value [prop=value ...]` (e.g. `hubspot create contacts email=a@b.com firstname=Ada`). Requires `<object>:write`.
Update a record: `hubspot update <object> <id> prop=value [...]` (PATCH). Requires `<object>:write`.
Owners: `hubspot owners [email=foo@bar.com]` (requires `owners:read`). Property metadata: `hubspot properties <object>` (requires `properties:read`).
Identity / connection check: `hubspot whoami` (account-info/v3/details).
Raw passthrough: `hubspot api <METHOD> <path> [field=value ...]` (e.g. `hubspot api GET /crm/v3/objects/deals limit=5`); GET/HEAD send fields as query params, others as a JSON body. HubSpot replies with JSON; errors are `{"status":"error","message":...,"category":...}`.
